thread:
ashwin: Heads-up — proposing a small-but-breaking API contract tweak: rename our SDK auth header from `X-Redwood-Key` -> `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Want to align with cloud marketplaces and hardware partners. Target deprecation window: 8 weeks.

lena: Oof, 8 weeks seems tight for marketplace syndication. Is this just header rename or more payload changes?

ashwin: Just header rename for now. No schema changes. But it is breaking for older embedded clients and partner firmware that hardcodes header name.

sami: From runtime side we can accept both headers for a transitional period. Suggest 12 weeks: dual-accept, emit warning header in responses, and a canary that rejects old header after 6 weeks for opt-in partners.

maria: Partner comms check — we need a single agreed timeline for public docs, marketplace vendor pages, and joint press if any. Also list of affected partners (SI integrators + 3 hardware OEMs). Who will own outreach?

ashwin: I can draft the partner note. Need engineering to +legal + marketplace GH owners signoff. Action: Sami to implement dual-header shim + warning; Maria to run partner list and outreach cadence; Lena to coordinate marketplace listing updates.

sami: I'll put up a PR: runtime will parse `Authorization` first, fall back to `X-Redwood-Key`, and add `Warning: X-Redwood-Key deprecated` response header. Canary rollout plan: 10% traffic in week 1, 30% week 2, 100% by week 4 for shim. After 12 weeks we'll flip on strict mode for selected partners.

ashwin: SDK plan: publish a patch that sets Authorization header by default and logs deprecation warnings. For breaking-major consumers, we'll release v2 with `Authorization` only. Maria — need partner testing window for SDKs.

maria: Can we give partners a test sandbox URL? We should include verification steps, sample curl, and short test matrix. I'll assemble.

ashwin: Sample curl for partners: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — also include fallback test with `X-Redwood-Key`.

lena: Marketplace ops: we must avoid breaking the managed marketplace connector. I'll open a ticket with the marketplace team to delay sync by 2 weeks if needed. Also confirm whether marketplace router rewrites headers.

ashwin: Good call. If marketplace rewrites, we need to update vendor connector docs and maybe release a short-lived proxy shim.

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: window=2026-04-02T12:00Z -> 2026-04-09T12:00Z, percent=10 -> 30 -> 100 (announced by @sami).

maria: Draft timeline proposal for partners: Week 0: partner heads-up + test sandbox; Week 1-4: SDK patches & runtime canary; Week 5-12: extended dual-accept & partner validations; Week 13: strict enforcement / off old header. Thoughts?

ashwin: Looks good. One ask: include a migration checklist for hardware partners — firmware, CI, and QA steps. Also propose a temporary compatibility flag `?compat=legacy` for partners who need extra runway.

sami: We can add query flag support in the router as a short-term escape hatch. Will require a quick integration test.

maria: I'll draft the partner note and the migration checklist, ping the OEM contacts, and schedule two 30-min syncs next week (one tech, one commercial).

ashwin: Thanks. I'll write an RFC and post to #devex + email partner-ops by EOD tomorrow. Assign owners in JIRA: ENG-PR-472 (runtime shim), SDK-137 (JS/Python patches), PART-88 (partner comms). :thumbsup:
